intro: A PvP preset for duels and the solo Abyss, a group-PvP protector, and the two PvE variants players actually run beside the Judgment tank: a damage Templar for when someone else holds the boss, and a solo farming setup. Each is drawn from at least three sites; KR/TW-only advice is marked.
crosscheck: The core of the planner's Judgment tank is what every source runs: Judgment, Vicious Strike, Pummel and Punishment first, Judgment to 16 for Remove cooldown as the first goal past 10, Fury as the top passive, and Doom Shield plus Battlefield Banner in the Stigma bar (Game8, aion2-meta.com, aion2-guides.info, ExpCarry, Skycoach, Fextralife, aion2.run). Game8's Judgment Templar PvE build (15 Oct) slots exactly the planner's four Stigmas, Doom Shield, Noble Armor, Battlefield Banner and Taunt. The fourth slot is where sources split: ExpCarry's sample of 200 Global Templars (17 Oct) has Doom Shield 60.5%, Noble Armor 57.5%, Battlefield Banner 52.5%, Empyrean Lord's Punishment 51%, Taunt 49.5% and Shield of Protection 41%, and the commonest exact bar swaps Taunt for Empyrean Lord's Punishment (only about 11% run any one bar); aion2-meta.com's top 28 Global Templars (15 Oct) run Doom Shield and Noble Armor at 96%, Battlefield Banner 93%, Shield of Protection 71% and Taunt 68%; aion2-guides.info and Fextralife keep Empyrean Lord's Punishment in place of Noble Armor; Skycoach runs Noble Armor, Doom Shield, Empyrean Lord's Punishment and Shield of Protection with no Taunt; aion2.run's expedition tank[kr] (like the Korean Inven guide)[/kr] makes Taunt and Shield of Protection core, which on Global's four slots costs Noble Armor. Specialties mostly agree; the differences are Warding Strike (Game8 and aion2.run take +100 Block during Warding where the planner takes Heal over Time), Shield Smite's Removes MP Cost pick (Game8, aion2.run, for mana) and Pummel, where aion2-guides.info follows Leonis on −1s Punishment cooldown like the planner but SolAshur takes the Punishing Strike HP absorb. Game8's macro (Pummel and Shield Rush, with the shield skills pressed in sequence) is far simpler than the planner's three-line macro, and ExpCarry keeps Doom Shield out of any macro because it moves you. Flash Rampage left at 1 matches aion2-meta.com (68% of top Global Templars leave it under 8) and aion2-guides.info.

builds.name: PvP Duelist
builds.role: Controller and attrition fighter (1v1 arena, solo Abyss)
builds.summary: A second skill preset that keeps the Judgment loop but trades threat and party tools for control, lifesteal and PvP mitigation: Doom Shield to engage, Executing Blade for a Defense cut before a charged Punishment, Second Skin against burst and Noble Armor always up. Templars rarely win fast; this build wins long fights.
builds.when: 1v1 arena, solo roaming in the Abyss (Lower Reshanta) and small skirmishes. For organised group fights use the Group PvP build.
builds.popularity: The Global PvP preset on Aion 2 Maps and both of aion2.run's Global builds for 1v1 arena and solo Abyss use these four Stigmas.[kr] Korean PvP data on aion2-meta.com (949 top players, 5–6 Stigma slots) shows Doom Shield on 98.9%, Second Skin 79%, Noble Armor 78.6% and Executing Blade 53.5%.[/kr] No site has Global PvP pick rates: ExpCarry notes the public armory doesn't separate PvP presets.
builds.vsMain: Stigmas: Executing Blade and Second Skin replace Taunt and Battlefield Banner; Executing Blade takes the 10. Skill points: Survival Willpower to 10, Impact Hit back to 1. Specialties swap damage-only picks for HP absorb, Knockdown chance and Status Effect Resist shred. Doom Shield comes out of the macro and is pressed by hand.

stigmas.name: Executing Blade
stigmas.why: −30% Defense for 5 s and more damage to a stunned or knocked-down target; at 10 Exposed, −50% Evasion and Block, so your burst lands

stigmas.name: Doom Shield
stigmas.why: 20 m rush, 75% Knockdown on players, a small shield and a Judgment window; at 5 it resets Annihilate. Your engage

stigmas.name: Second Skin
stigmas.why: +15% PvP Damage Tolerance for 12 s every 90 s: pop it when their burst comes. A buff, not a shield, so Blade Toss doesn't break it

stigmas.name: Noble Armor
stigmas.why: +7% Max HP and +5% Defense, up all the time, and buff removal can't strip it. Armor of Balance in its slot against Assassins and Gladiators

builds.daevanion: Azphel, the PvP board, on its own crystals (36 from Ereshkigal's Monolith in Season 1, 110 more from the Abyss Shop): core PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance nodes first, then Status Effect Resist, then Chance; which of Boost or Tolerance first is a split. The four PvE boards stay on the main route.
builds.gear: Abyssal Manastones with PvP lines (PvP Attack, Accuracy, Block, Defense); Accuracy before Block; Status Effect Resist on armour lines and Status Effect Chance on the Natura Genus slots, since your stuns miss without it.[kr] Brawler Wings or Talisra Wings (each on about a quarter of Korea's top PvP players).[/kr] The Fierce Battle Amulet (PvP Damage Boost 20%) in place of the Revelation Amulet. Attack title: Saint of Ereshkigal or Treading on White/Black Wings (PvP Damage Boost 4%). Keep one Genus preset for PvP: PvE-only lines do nothing to players.
play: Doom Shield in first to bait their Defiance; Annihilate the knockdown if it lands.
Ride out their 5 s of Tenacity with lifesteal picks, then chain: Poach (pull, root, −20% Status Effect Resist), Shield Smite stun, Judgment and Pummel.
On the stun or knockdown: Executing Blade, then a fully charged Punishment.
Second Skin when their burst starts; Warding Strike from the macro adds PvP Damage Tolerance.
Keep Doom Shield and Shield Rush to close the gap, not as damage buttons, and hold one control chain in reserve.
Wait out Tenaciousness, Salvation, Hibernation and Barrier Spell before spending a stun or Punishment.
Keep the macro for Annihilate only and press defensives and Defiance yourself; strafe to their back when you can.
pros: Very hard to kill; wins long fights
Most crowd control of any class, with a 20 m pull
Same skill core as PvE, so little extra gear
cons: Slow kills and little mobility; kited by ranged classes
[kr]Rated weak in 1v1 by Korean players since the 16 Sep patch, which cut drains (aion2.run)[/kr]
[kr]Struggles against a good Gladiator at equal gear[/kr]

builds.name: Group PvP Protector
builds.role: Front-line puller and peeler (5v5 arena, group Abyss, battlegrounds)
builds.summary: The Templar's job in group fights is not kills: pull their healer or a squishy DPS into your team, lock targets, and keep your own healers alive with party mitigation. Comrade in Arms, Grapple and Nezekan's Shield are the group Stigmas every source names.
builds.when: 5v5 arena, Abyss skirmishes and bosses with a group, 10v10 battlegrounds (stats equalised, so utility is all you bring).
builds.popularity: aion2.run's 5v5, group Abyss and battleground builds, Game8's group PvP bar and Gamers Together's group PvP build all use Comrade in Arms and Grapple, and ExpCarry's PvP tool list includes Grapple and Nezekan's Shield.[kr] Both are top Korean PvP picks on aion2-meta.com (88.3% and 79.2%, with 5–6 slots), and FMKorea posts call Comrade in Arms the party-fight Stigma.[/kr]
builds.vsMain: All four Stigmas change: Comrade in Arms, Grapple and Nezekan's Shield for Taunt, Battlefield Banner and Noble Armor; Doom Shield stays to engage. Skill points as the PvP Duelist, with Warding Strike, Poach and Shield Smite earlier and Impact Hit at 1.

stigmas.name: Nezekan's Shield
stigmas.why: Shields you and the party within 40 m: 45% of Max HP for 3 s at 5, 50% for 5 s at 10, every 60 s. Pop it as their burst lands

stigmas.name: Comrade in Arms
stigmas.why: +10% PvP Damage Tolerance for 6 s and splits each hit on a nearby ally with you, every 120 s. Save it for the fight-deciding moment; Game8 takes it to 20 first after 45

stigmas.name: Grapple
stigmas.why: Pulls up to four enemies near a target 20 m away to you and roots them for 3 s: drag their back line into yours

stigmas.name: Doom Shield
stigmas.why: Engage and chase: 20 m rush, Knockdown chance and a Judgment window. Shield of Protection in its slot when you are peeling, not diving

builds.daevanion: Azphel as in the PvP Duelist: core PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance first, then Status Effect Resist; lean to Tolerance and Resist since you soak.
builds.gear: Same PvP base as the PvP Duelist, tilted to survival: HP and PvP Damage Tolerance, then Status Effect Resist, then Accuracy (aion2.run). Status Effect Chance still matters so Grapple and stuns land.
play: Decide before the push whether you engage or peel; call it on voice.
Engaging: Doom Shield or Poach onto their healer, Grapple the cluster, Shield Smite and Annihilate while your team bursts.
Peeling: stay on your healers, Nezekan's Shield on the incoming burst, Comrade in Arms when an ally gets focused.
Pull flying or fleeing targets with Poach; hold Defiance for the stun that matters.
In battlegrounds play the objective, not kills.
pros: What groups want a Templar for: pulls, stuns and party mitigation
Grapple and Poach split enemy formations
Good even with modest gear (battlegrounds equalise stats)
cons: Long cooldowns (Comrade in Arms 120 s, Grapple 90 s) punish bad timing

builds.name: Damage Templar
builds.role: Damage-leaning off-tank and PvX (second Templar, farming groups, open world)
builds.summary: The same Judgment and Punishment engine with the threat tools traded for damage and stagger: Empyrean Lord's Punishment takes Taunt's slot. SolAshur's 'DPS Templar' thesis is that one damage-first PvX set beats separate sets for most players; ExpCarry's Global sample shows this bar as the single most common one.
builds.when: When another tank holds the boss, in a raid's second subgroup, in groups where threat is already safe, and in the open world or rifts. Not as the only tank on a hard boss.
builds.popularity: Doom Shield, Noble Armor, Battlefield Banner and Empyrean Lord's Punishment is the commonest exact bar among 200 Global Templars (ExpCarry, 17 Oct), though only about 11% run it exactly; Empyrean Lord's Punishment sits on 51% of them.[kr] aion2.run notes Korea's high-damage Templars sometimes out-damage Gladiators (Inven, Sep 2026).[/kr]
builds.vsMain: Empyrean Lord's Punishment replaces Taunt (Executing Blade in its place for farming and PvX). Debilitating Smash, Impact Hit and Punishing Benediction move up the point order; Enhance Health and Ironclad Defense move to the end. Insulting Roar's threat matters less.

builds.daevanion: As the main build: Judgment, Punishment and Pummel nodes first on each board, then Shield Smite and Annihilate, then Combat Speed and Damage Boost; skip MP, Flash Rampage and Warding Shield nodes.
builds.gear: Damage everywhere once threat is someone else's job: Attack, Critical Hit and Accuracy as the core trio, Combat Speed and Weapon Damage Boost on weapon and guard, Critical Damage Boost on the shoulders, Perfect Chance; Judgment, Punishment and Pummel lines on rings and Arcana (SolAshur, TW-based). Front Attack Damage Boost only helps when you face the boss.
play: Fully buff (Noble Armor, Battlefield Banner), close in, then a fully charged Punishment.
Spend each Judgment window before firing the next trigger; Doom Shield after Shield Smite and Warding Strike to extend it.
Empyrean Lord's Punishment when the stagger gauge opens or for burst; Annihilate on every proc.
Re-charge Punishment as soon as it is back; keep Executor up.
Swap Taunt back in if you end up holding the boss.
pros: Highest Templar damage[kr]; can rival damage classes when geared[/kr]
Stagger and a stun for the party
Works for PvX: one preset for rifts, open world and groups
cons: No Taunt, so not for solo-tanking hard bosses
[kr]Leans on macros, a good PC and low ping[/kr]
Gives up Taunt's Shrink, which lowers the boss's PvE Damage Tolerance for the whole party

builds.name: Solo Farmer
builds.role: Solo farming and open-world questing at 45
builds.summary: Templars kill slowly alone, so this setup goes for zero downtime: life-drain picks so you never stop to heal, resets on kill (Poach now, Doom Shield at Stigma 15), and Grapple to gather a full pack of four for Warding Strike and a charged Punishment.
builds.when: Open-world farming, district quests, sealed dungeons, pet-soul and Abyss mob farming. For dungeons, swap back to the main build.
builds.popularity: aion2.run, aion2-guides.info, Gamers Together and ExpCarry all list a separate solo preset; aion2-meta.com rates the Templar B tier for farming. The exact bar varies more than in any other Templar build.
builds.vsMain: Grapple replaces Taunt; Empyrean Lord's Punishment replaces Noble Armor; Doom Shield takes the 10 and heads for 15. Specialties swap to HP absorbs and the Poach reset. Insulting Roar falls to the last row.

skills.note: row 7 (378 of 383; 5 spare). Flash Rampage, Survival Willpower, Guarding Seal and Warding Shield at 1

builds.daevanion: The main route: Judgment, Punishment and Pummel nodes first, then Combat Speed and Damage Boost; Annihilate and Shield Smite nodes help packs. No farming-specific board.
builds.gear: Attack and Damage Boost, Multi-Hit, Combat Speed, then HP absorb and HP (aion2.run). A cheap separate preset: it uses your PvE gear.
play: Grapple a pack (or Poach one mob; a kill resets Poach), Empyrean Lord's Punishment to stun, Warding Strike, then a full Punishment.
Hold Vicious Strike and the macro; Doom Shield to the next pack.
Chain medium packs rather than huge pulls that force you to stop and heal.
Keep Warding Strike for the pack that actually threatens your HP.
From Doom Shield 15, a macro line of Doom Shield, Annihilate, Debilitating Smash and Pummel keeps resetting on kills (SolAshur, TW-based).
pros: Almost no downtime: heals itself through drains, Warding Strike and Guarding Seal
Rarely dies, so it suits open-world and Abyss farming
cons: Slower kills than Gladiator, Assassin or ranged classes
Every area skill stops at four targets
Doom Shield's reset needs Stigma 15, past the 30 points you have at 45
